purpose: Define the exact public-safe write contract for saving PMP Inventory Eyes / Lossless Quality reports into the PMP Lossless Inventory Vault.

name_boundary.vault_github_writer: Role that writes public-safe lossless/inventory reports into GitHub vault files.
name_boundary.pmp_vault_github_shortcut: Primary current private writer implementation using Apple Shortcuts on the user's iPhone.
name_boundary.safe_writer: Separate existing PMP code/app writing tool. Do not confuse the two.
name_boundary.cloudflare_worker: Removed from active plan. Do not use unless later explicitly revived.

shortcut_write_steps: Shortcut name: PMP Vault GitHub Writer.
Shortcut parses clipboard as JSON dictionary.
Shortcut verifies packet.writer_name is Vault GitHub Writer.
Shortcut verifies privacy_gate passes exactly: no private Bug Memory, no Apple Notes contents, no tokens, no passwords, no secrets, no private values, localStorage key names only.
Shortcut sends a GitHub API PUT request to write packet.report to pmp-lossless-inventory-vault/current.json.
Shortcut may also write packet.report to packet.target_history.
Shortcut shows a compact write receipt.
hard_blocks: Any token/password/secret present in packet or report.
Any private Bug Memory record value present in packet or report.
Any Apple Notes private content present in packet or report.
Any private localStorage value present instead of key name only.
allowed_writers: PMP Vault GitHub Shortcut controlled by the user
ChatGPT GitHub connector action approved by the user
forbidden_writers: public GitHub Pages HTML containing a GitHub token
public JavaScript containing a GitHub token
Cloudflare Worker path unless later explicitly revived by user
any writer that stores private Bug Memory or Apple Notes contents in this vault
next_step: Create the iPhone Shortcut named PMP Vault GitHub Writer and wire the app to open it after copying the Vault Write Packet to clipboard.
